notes.summary: Art & Culture gives 1–2 questions. The favourites are classical and folk dances with their states, famous monuments and who built them, musicians and their instruments, and state festivals.

concepts.title: Classical dances of India
concepts.body:
The Sangeet Natak Akademi recognises eight classical dances:
DanceState
BharatanatyamTamil Nadu
KathakUttar Pradesh (North India)
KathakaliKerala
MohiniyattamKerala
KuchipudiAndhra Pradesh
OdissiOdisha
ManipuriManipur
SattriyaAssam
Kerala has two classical forms.

concepts.title: Monuments and builders
concepts.body:
MonumentPlaceBuilt by
Taj MahalAgraShah Jahan
Qutub MinarDelhiAibak (begun), Iltutmish (completed)
Brihadeeswarar TempleThanjavurRajaraja I (Chola)
Konark Sun TempleOdishaNarasimhadeva I (Eastern Ganga)
Khajuraho templesMadhya PradeshChandela rulers
Buland DarwazaFatehpur SikriAkbar
Gol GumbazVijayapura (Bijapur)Muhammad Adil Shah
Ajanta caves (Maharashtra) are famous for Buddhist paintings; Ellora has Hindu, Buddhist and Jain caves, including the Kailasa temple.

concepts.title: Musicians and their instruments
concepts.body:
InstrumentMaestro
SitarPt. Ravi Shankar
ShehnaiUstad Bismillah Khan
TablaUstad Zakir Hussain, Ustad Alla Rakha
SantoorPt. Shivkumar Sharma
Flute (bansuri)Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia
SarodUstad Amjad Ali Khan
Indian classical music has two streams: Hindustani (North) and Carnatic (South).

varieties.name: Dance ↔ state
varieties.how: Recall the eight classical dances with states, then common folk dances.

example.q: Sattriya is a classical dance of which state?
steps: Sattriya grew in the Vaishnava monasteries (sattras) of Assam

varieties.name: Monument ↔ builder / place
varieties.how: Link the monument to its dynasty, then the ruler.

example.q: Who built the Brihadeeswarar Temple at Thanjavur?

varieties.name: Musicians and festivals
varieties.how: Pair each maestro with one instrument; pair each festival with its state.

example.q: Ustad Bismillah Khan is associated with which instrument?
steps: Bismillah Khan of Varanasi made the shehnai famous on the concert stage

tips: Kerala has two classical dances: Kathakali (dance-drama, heavy make-up) and Mohiniyattam (graceful, solo female).
Kuchipudi takes its name from a village in Andhra Pradesh.
Questions on maestros usually pick from the six in the table; learn them as pairs.
traps: Bihu is both a dance and a festival of Assam; Sattriya, not Bihu, is the classical dance of Assam.
Kathakali (Kerala) and Kathak (North India) sound alike but are different.
Yakshagana (Karnataka) is a traditional theatre form, not one of the eight classical dances.

questions.q: Kuchipudi is a classical dance form of which state?
questions.solution:
Kuchipudi comes from the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh.
Memory hook: Kuchipudi is named after its home village in AP.

questions.q: The Taj Mahal was built by:
questions.solution:
Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal at Agra in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
Memory hook: Shah Jahan, the 'builder emperor': Taj Mahal and the Red Fort of Delhi.

questions.q: Pandit Shivkumar Sharma was a famous player of which instrument?
questions.solution:
Pt. Shivkumar Sharma popularised the santoor, a hammered string instrument from Jammu and Kashmir, in classical music.
Memory hook: Shivkumar Sharma — Santoor.

questions.q: Which state has two classical dance forms recognised by the Sangeet Natak Akademi?
questions.solution:
Kerala has Kathakali and Mohiniyattam.
Memory hook: Kerala = 'K' and 'M': Kathakali and Mohiniyattam.

questions.q: The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in:
questions.solution:
The Hornbill Festival is held every December in Nagaland and showcases its tribes.
Memory hook: The hornbill bird is honoured in Naga culture: Hornbill = Nagaland.

questions.q: The Konark Sun Temple is located in which state?
questions.solution:
The Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha; it was built by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty in the 13th century. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Memory hook: Konark is shaped like the Sun God's chariot, on the Odisha coast.

questions.q: Which of the following pairs (dance — state) is incorrectly matched?
questions.solution:
Ghoomar is a folk dance of Rajasthan. Gujarat's famous folk dance is Garba.
Memory hook: Ghoomar 'twirls' in the royal courts of Rajasthan.

questions.q: The Kailasa temple, carved out of a single rock, is part of which cave complex?
questions.solution:
The Kailasa temple (Cave 16) at Ellora, Maharashtra, was carved from one rock under the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I.
Memory hook: Ajanta = paintings, Ellora = rock-cut Kailasa.
